outcome: Likelihood of being a general facility
cohort: 111 private and 47 public facilities in three districts of Gujarat, India, that conducted births between June 2012 and April 2013; 90 private facilities performing cesarean sections were eligible for the CY program
finding: Private obstetricians participating in the CY program were more likely to be new to private practice, provide general services, conduct fewer cesareans, and be less expensive, although these factors were not significant in a multivariate model.
mod_finding: The CY remuneration package design may be effective in keeping cesarean rates in check.
